title: Decoupling Reconnaissance and Exploitation: Measuring the Capability Boundaries of LLM-Based Web Penetration Testing
title_zh: 解耦侦察与利用：衡量基于LLM的Web渗透测试能力边界
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for automated penetration testing, yet existing end-to-end black-box evaluations are highly susceptible to error cascading: failures in early reconnaissance can mask an agent's actual ability to exploit vulnerabilities. To more accurately characterize these capabilities, we propose a two-stage decoupled evaluation framework that separates exploit execution from reconnaissance. Using ground-truth injection and knowledge-driven ablation across 70 high-fidelity web vulnerability testbeds, our framework isolates exploitation performance from reconnaissance noise. We empirically evaluate five open-source penetration-testing agents, covering multiagent, monolithic, and graph-driven architectures, on a strictly aligned subset of 50 representative vulnerabilities. The results reveal a substantial capability gap. With accurate vulnerability context, agents achieve a functional success rate of up to 90.0%, whereas autonomous reconnaissance, measured by targeted vulnerability recall, plateaus at approximately 50.0%, primarily due to failures in parsing unstructured telemetry. Cross-architectural analysis further reveals distinct capability niches: multi-agent isolation is more effective for long-sequence interactions such as de-serialization, while monolithic and graph-driven designs perform better on short-chain injections and cross-session access-control vulnerabilities, respectively. This decoupled evaluation work provides a fine-grained benchmarking protocol and an empirical basis for designing next-generation automated offensive security agents.
abstract_zh: 本文指出，现有基于LLM的端到端黑盒渗透测试评估容易受到“前序侦察失败导致后续利用能力被掩盖”的误差级联影响。为更准确刻画模型能力，作者提出一个两阶段解耦评估框架，将漏洞利用执行与侦察发现分离，并通过ground-truth injection与knowledge-driven ablation，在70个高保真Web漏洞测试床上进行测评。研究在严格对齐的50个代表性漏洞子集上评估了5种开源渗透测试agent，涵盖multiagent、monolithic和graph-driven三类架构。结果表明：当提供准确漏洞上下文时，agent的功能性成功率最高可达90.0%；而自主侦察的目标漏洞召回率仅约50.0%，主要瓶颈在于对非结构化telemetry的解析失败。进一步分析显示，不同架构存在互补优势：multi-agent更适合长链路交互如de-serialization，monolithic与graph-driven则分别在短链注入和跨会话访问控制漏洞上表现更好。该工作为自动化进攻安全agent提供了更细粒度的benchmark协议与设计依据。
key_points_zh: 提出将Web渗透测试拆分为侦察与利用的两阶段解耦评估框架，减少误差级联干扰。
在70个高保真Web漏洞测试床上，结合ground-truth injection与knowledge-driven ablation评估5种开源agent。
结果显示：给定准确漏洞上下文时，利用成功率可达90.0%，但自主侦察的漏洞召回率仅约50.0%。
主要瓶颈来自对非结构化telemetry的解析失败，而非纯粹的利用执行能力不足。
不同架构各有优势：multi-agent更擅长长链路交互，monolithic与graph-driven分别在短链注入和跨会话访问控制上更强。

llm_assessment.comment: This paper improves offensive agent evaluation by decoupling reconnaissance from exploitation to isolate true capability boundaries.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这篇论文通过将侦察与利用解耦来改进攻击型代理评估，从而更准确地刻画能力边界。
